title: Royal Horse Cavalry & Camel Parade
subtitle: Centuries of Regal Heritage on the Old Parade Ground Track
summary: Witness over two hundred champion stallions adorned in brocade, velvet, and beaten brass, guided by traditional cavalry units and royal camel parades across the central arena.
features: Traditional cavalry salutes and high-speed gallop displays
Ancient brass instruments, kakaki trumpets, and ceremonial drums
Royal equestrian gear craft exhibition and harness leatherwork
Presidential box review and ceremonial honors parade

title: Fresh Meat & Live-Weight Market
subtitle: Modernized Trade Exchange with Precision Electronic Scales
summary: Experience the transformation of Nigerian livestock commerce from arbitrary eye-estimation to certified live-weight kilogram pricing with instant electronic settlement.
features: Certified digital weighing platforms for cattle, sheep, and camels
Direct farm-gate price transparency with zero intermediary markups
Bank of Agriculture & commercial settlement kiosks for cash-free transactions
Mobile veterinary inspection tags guaranteeing disease-free stock

title: Twilight Suya & Culinary Village
subtitle: Celebrating Nigeria's Renowned Artisanal Smoked Meats
summary: Sample the finest cuts of beef, tender lamb, and spiced goat prepared over slow embers by the nation's premier suya artisans following verified hygienic standards.
features: Master Suya Guild national championship and secret spice blend showcase
Hygienic prep zones with continuous temperature-controlled displays
Kilishi craft demonstrations and vacuum-sealed gift packaging for export
Open-air seating pavilion with traditional evening musical interludes

title: National Championship Breed Judging
subtitle: Elite Pastoral Genetics, Conformation & Breed Excellence
summary: The premier stage for pastoralists showcasing purebred Sokoto Gudali, White Fulani, Red Bororo, and dual-hump Sahelian camels evaluated by certified veterinary judges.
features: Comprehensive scoring: skeletal conformation, weight-for-age, and milk/meat ratios
Presidential gold medals, breed rosettes, and prize breeding bulls
AI (Artificial Insemination) and genetic improvement clinics for smallholders
Official breed studbook registry certificates issued on site

title: Digital Traceability & Cold-Chain Pavilion
subtitle: Unlocking Global Export Markets Through Quality Infrastructure
summary: Explore cutting-edge biometric cattle ear-tagging, cloud-connected veterinary health ledgers, and containerized modular abattoirs meeting international export protocols.
features: Live RFID ear-tag scanning and cloud ledger telemetry demonstrations
Mobile modular abattoir walk-through with sterile stainless steel processing lines
-18°C reefer transport and air cargo logistics coordination desks
NHESICS export certification registration and documentation support

title: Renewed Hope Cultural & Unity Pageant
subtitle: Unifying Geopolitical Zones Through Agricultural Heritage
summary: A colorful celebration bridging pastoral communities, agrarian feed producers, and coastal maritime export ports in a shared economic and cultural triumph.
features: Traditional dance troupes from northern, eastern, and western pastoral corridors
Indigenous leatherwork, saddle embroidery, and cattle-horn artisanal crafts
Youth agricultural innovation fair and future farmers masterclasses
Grand evening national unity concert and illumination ceremony
